question: after a breakout of the prior 12 completed bars, does EURUSD continue? Measured on longer bar scales because Exp04 showed the M5 effect is far too small to pay cost.

data.missing_data_policy: a bar holding less than min_m1_ratio of the theoretical M1 count is sparse; any lookback or holding window containing a sparse bar is dropped and the drop is counted

method.return: signed so positive always means continued

bar_construction.H4: 4h buckets aligned to the 06:00 Beijing FX origin

method.lookahead: none: signal and entry use bars <= i+1 only

is_oos.note: same split as exp01-exp04, not selected here

method.uncertainty: calendar-month block bootstrap; signals treated as clustered, not independent
method.overlap: measured on bar positions with a greedy non-overlapping subset

m5_reproducibility_anchor.note: must reproduce the frozen Exp04 report; if it does not, this run is invalid

reason: every cell negative after round-trip cost
direction inconsistent across direction x horizon
direction inconsistent across direction x horizon

verdict_rules.NOT ESTABLISHED: not positive net of round-trip cost, OR inconsistent sign across direction/horizon, OR IS/OOS sign mismatch, OR best single year carries > 50% of |yearly contribution|

caveats: Event study, not a strategy: no stops, targets, sizing or filters.
Signals recur within the same move; windows overlap. Reported.
Raw pips are not comparable across bar scales; use mean/sd.
Round-trip cost is assumed; overnight financing is swept, not assumed.
A surviving direction is still not a tradable strategy.
